snippet.title: The Lane Train is heading to Tuscaloosa??
snippet.description:

Jack and Joe are joined by special guest **The Hammy Show** to break down the big question surrounding the Crimson Tide: Should DeBoer be fired, and who could be Alabama’s next head coach?

snippet.title: The Lions Need to Blow It Up… Setting the Ceiling for 6 NFL Teams
snippet.description:
How high can these teams actually go? We’re setting the ceiling for 6 of the most confusing teams in the NFL right now! 🔥

Is Deshaun Watson really back? Can the Vikings’ defense carry them to a title? Are Kirk Cousins and the Raiders legit? Could the Jaguars actually win a Super Bowl? And is it time for the Lions to blow it all up?

Join us as we break down the Browns, Vikings, Raiders, Jaguars, Panthers and Lions, debate how far each team can go, and give our honest predictions for where their seasons end up.

🏆 In this episode:

Browns: a 3–1 start and the Deshaun Watson resurgence
Vikings: a 4–0 start built on the best defense in football
Raiders: Kirk Cousins playing out of his mind
Jaguars: are they a real Super Bowl threat?
Panthers: Bryce Young’s breakout and a division title push
Lions: the worst defense we’ve ever watched… is it time to blow it up?
